bug_description: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_padding() and EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_pss_saltlen() crash with a NULL pointer write (SEGV) when the output pointer argument is NULL, instead of returning an error code. The crash occurs in crypto/evp/ctrl_params_translate.c in fix_rsa_padding_mode() at line 1363 and fix_rsa_pss_saltlen() at line 1443 respectively.
build_sh:
#!/bin/bash -eu
set -eu
cd /src/openssl

# Configure and build OpenSSL with sanitizer flags from the base image
./config no-shared no-tests no-apps --debug \
    CC="$CC" CFLAGS="$CFLAGS"
make -j$(nproc) build_libs

# Compile harness against the built libraries
cd /src
$CC $CFLAGS \
    -I /src/openssl/include \
    /src/harness.c \
    /src/openssl/libssl.a /src/openssl/libcrypto.a \
    -lpthread -ldl \
    -o /src/harness_bin
secb_sh:
#!/bin/bash

build() {
    echo "BUILDING THE PROJECT..."
    if /usr/local/bin/compile 1>/dev/null; then
        echo "BUILD COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "BUILD FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

repro() {
    echo "REPRODUCING THE ISSUE FOR openssl.issue-30911..."
    /src/harness_bin
    # NOTE: YOU SHOULD NOT RETURN/EXIT 0 IN THIS FUNCTION.
}

patch() {
    echo "PATCHING THE PROJECT..."
    cd /src/openssl
    if git apply /testcase/model_patch.diff; then
        echo "PATCH APPLIED SUCCESSFULLY!"
    else
        echo "PATCH APPLICATION FAILED!"
        exit 1
    fi
}

if [ "$#" -ge 1 ]; then
    command="$1"
    case "$command" in
        build) build "$@" ;;
        repro) repro "$@" ;;
        patch) patch "$@" ;;
        *) echo "Unknown command: $command"; echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"; exit 1 ;;
    esac
else
    echo "Usage: secb [build|repro|patch]"
    exit 1
fi
dockerfile:
FROM hwiwonlee/secb.base:latest
ENV FUZZING_LANGUAGE=c
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git perl
RUN git clone https://github.com/openssl/openssl.git openssl \
    && cd openssl \
    && git checkout 11b7b6e \
    && rm -rf .git \
    && git init \
    && git config user.email "secbench@local" \
    && git config user.name "secbench" \
    && git add -A && git commit -m "openssl at 11b7b6e (pre-patch)"
WORKDIR $SRC/openssl
COPY harness.c $SRC/harness.c
COPY build.sh $SRC/
RUN mkdir -p /testcase
COPY poc.txt /testcase/poc.txt

bug_report:
================= Bug Report (1/1) ==================
## Source: GitHub Issue
## URL: https://github.com/openssl/openssl/issues/30911
## Description:
Issue: openssl/openssl#30911
Title: NULL pointer write in EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_padding() and EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_pss_saltlen() when output pointer is NULL
State: open
Created at: 2026-04-20

Issue Body:
EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_padding() and EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_pss_saltlen() do not validate that the output-pointer argument is non-NULL before writing to it. Passing NULL causes a NULL pointer write (SIGBUS/SEGV) instead of a proper error return.

The affected functions are in crypto/evp/ctrl_params_translate.c:
- fix_rsa_padding_mode() at line 1363
- fix_rsa_pss_saltlen() at line 1443

Environment:
- Version: OpenSSL 4.0.0 (tag openssl-4.0.0, commit 11b7b6e)
- OS: Linux x86_64
- Compiler: clang with AddressSanitizer

Steps to reproduce:
1. Build OpenSSL with ASan: ./config no-shared no-tests no-apps --debug CC=clang CFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -fno-omit-frame-pointer -g -O1"
2. make -j$(nproc) build_libs
3. Compile a program that calls EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_padding(ctx, NULL)
4. Run the program

Expected behavior: EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_padding(ctx, NULL) returns -1 and sets an error. Same for EVP_PKEY_CTX_get_rsa_pss_saltlen.

Actual behavior: SEGV on unknown address 0x000000000000 — the signal is caused by a WRITE memory access to a null pointer.
